title: 36 Hours in Philadelphia
abstract: Philadelphia may be the birthplace of American democracy, but its world-class museums and thrilling dining scene are just as revolutionary.

title: 36 Hours in Lecce, Italy
abstract: In sun-drenched southern Italy, this immaculately preserved Baroque city is far more than a fetching fossil.

title: 36 Hours in Bruges, Belgium
abstract: Like the works of the Flemish painters who once inhabited the city, Bruges’s appeal lies in the details.

title: 36 Hours on the Oregon Coast
abstract: Pensive but pretty, the state’s northernmost reaches promise fresh seafood, local art and plenty of outdoorsy diversions.

title: 36 Hours on Sifnos, Greece
abstract: Coastal trails, whitewashed monasteries and thrilling new takes on traditional Greek cuisine make this uncrowded island worth the trip.
